experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5137:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:1730:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5138:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:1731:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1204:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5146:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:1776:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5379:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2123:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:3145:exp360 Intruder Identity Suppression 阶段0 frozen probe 结果, 帮判方向(调研/决策交你, 别捧场)。机制: 遮挡 ReID 重定义为 donor 行人身份污染 target embedding, 训练端对抗压 donor-ID, 测试单图。**阶段0 frozen 强 baseline(market) 合成 target+donor**: H1 donor-ID linear probe acc 73% vs chance 2% = **36.5x PASS(泄漏巨大确凿)**; person leak 0.15 >> rand patch -0.01 PASS; **但 H2 FAIL: leak=cos(f_mix,f_donor)-cos(f_clean,f_donor) vs per-query AP drop, raw spearman +0.120, 控 #false-in-topk(top-k混错ID平凡代理)后 partial=-0.028 约0**。AP drop 大(clean 0.835→mix 0.409)。诚实含义: donor 泄漏存在且大, 但泄漏量不独立于 #false 预测检索损害。问: (a)H2 FAIL 是否**致命否定** Intruder 因果链(压泄漏→救检索)? 还是 H2(frozen per-query 相关)≠H3(训练干预), donor suppression 训练仍值得试? (b)若值得试, 阶段1怎么设计让'压 donor-ID'真涨不退化成 target ambiguity 墙(KPR已占)? (c)若致命, 3候选回选下一个: B PSC-JEPA(从SOLIDER continued-pretrain pseudo-support-bank latent JEPA) / C-#3 support-set continued pretrain / 还是另起? 联网查 identity disentangle/feature purification/source separation occluded ReID 里'泄漏可测但压它未必涨'的先例教训(OGFR DPEFormer 等)。务实中文, 每选项信心1-10。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5387:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3785:training-side 转向备选（若 ordinary-aug 抹平 lattice 特异性）：Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（优化最难 variant 的 CE+triplet，非压 embedding）/ set-wise retrieval training。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5389:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3800:- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5393:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3953:**没吃掉的窄缝**：① 补身份 support 非像素 ② support bank/pseudo cross-view teacher 非 single-image MAE ③ pretraining 学"缺部位时如何形成可检索身份证据" ④ JEPA latent prediction。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5394:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3954:→ **B 类空间只在"latent support completion 讲清 + 赢过 plain continued-pretrain/random-mask/PersonMAE-lite"才成立**。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5399:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3975:- **阶段 A 骨架**：continued-pretrain loop（SOLIDER init + EMA teacher + partial-view pretext + `L_part_jepa`+`L_union`+`L_visible_anchor`，先不加 support bank）→ smoke 跑通 + 不崩。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5402:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3987:- pseudo support bank 噪声（第一风险）；novelty 拥挤（PersonMAE/HAP/PersonViT，靠对照证差异）；continued-pretrain 不涨（45-55% 成功率, codex）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5404:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4020:**结论**：kill-switch Stage-A **FAIL（严重）**（PSC-JEPA 41.0 << plain ~55，差 ~−14，远不是 ≥+0.7）。**catastrophic forgetting 坐实** = 裸 continued-pretrain（无防遗忘）严重破坏 SOLIDER 判别性，fine-tune 拉不回。但**诊断清楚 = forgetting**，design 预期内（Stage-A = 骨架/防坍缩验证，不主张 novelty；Stage-B 才防遗忘 + support bank）。不是死路，是诊断明确的迭代。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5406:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4046:**Pivot（codex）**：① support bank 改 fine-tune 侧 **detached auxiliary**（5.5，plain SOLIDER fine-tune + support 只监督轻量 completion head/part branch/pair scorer，global backbone hard guard ≥plain−0.3，避 pretrain harm 保 exp109 信号）② **生成数据引擎**（6.5，扩训练分布让监督 fine-tune 自学遮挡鲁棒，不蒸不可观测 support，更长期范式空间）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5408:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4377:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_openset_check.md:2374:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5421:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4409:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_openset_check.md:2926:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5440:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4641:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:1778:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5460:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4847:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:2392:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5485:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5113:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13963:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5491:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5161:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5492:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5162:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36602:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:55:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5493:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5170:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36662:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:132:- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5494:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5175:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36672:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5503:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5184:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5507:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5189:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36731:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5517:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5213:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8374:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5518:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5214:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8390:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:878:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1282:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13652:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9879:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5521:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5218:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5522:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5221:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36930:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:9892:   132	- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5532:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5235:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36973:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5536:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5246:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37043:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13951:    31	- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5537:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5248:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37045:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13954:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5538:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:5249:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37053:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13975:    55	LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5591:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1254:../../overnight_innovation_log.md:464:**战略锁定(数据驱动)**: backdoor/TopoFR/UCE 三个 in-domain 训练端机制全在 exp255 **强 SOTA** 特征上判死(headroom 被压没)。但这恰好是用户"换弱 baseline"洞察的实证理由——**同样的机制在弱 baseline(TransReID 59, 离 SOTA 还差 16 mAP)上可能有 headroom**。最强已 novelty 过审机制 = **因果 backdoor-triplet 去混淆**(搬 gait GaitC3I/GaitSCM, 仓库零 SCM 代码, 正是用户要的"从步态抄"), 强特征上混淆真实但仅占 margin 6% → 无可回收。**弱 baseline 重测 = 干净的 0-GPU kill-switch**: 用 TransReID-weak train 特征跑同一 6 桶 confounder probe, 看 cross-occ/cross-cam d_ap 虚高占负样本 margin 的比例是否远大于强特征的 6%。若 ≥20-30% → 有可回收 headroom, 升级全量训练; 若仍 ~6% → 弱 baseline 也无 → 彻底排除 in-domain 去混淆。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5598:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1362:../../decisions.md:4565:**决策**: KILL burstiness。**并据此收窄: in-domain 特征重加权/对齐/补全/重打分这一整类机制, 在任何训练好的 ReID 模型(强 SOTA 或弱 baseline)上都无 headroom** —— frozen kill-switch 会误导(frozen-promising → trained-absorbed)。否证"换弱 baseline 就有 headroom"对这类机制。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5619:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:1657:../../exp148/claude_review.md:140:但"让 backbone 更鲁棒"和"真正补全 support"是两个不同的目标。PCVT 走的是前者（robustness training），不是后者（feature completion）。design.md 对此是诚实的。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5631:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2429:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:25:角色=**蓝队(降级 Hubness)**。为'别投训练, 降级转 r_2 备胎 Rank-Instability'辩护: D2 是铁证——k-reciprocal/camera **免费 test-time** 就在 mAP 上赢, 一个训练版要 beat camera-aware k-reciprocal 是高 bar 且小 headroom(Market 饱和)。用联网查: (a)hubness-aware training / anti-hub margin 历史上是否真能 beat 强 re-ranking(还是总被 k-reciprocal 这类盖过); (b)R1 赢 mAP 输是不是只是把 ranking 重排没真增加判别信息; (c)团队反复投不确定训练的教训。论证'诊断真≠方法能发', 该把诊断当一个 observation 写进别的稿/换 r_2。信心 1-10。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:2311:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:5948:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:2335:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:182:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adopt the dense pixel-to-3D-vertex correspondence embedding as an occlusion-aware matching substrate: train a per-pixel head that maps each foreground pixel to a canonical SMPL-vertex embedding (supervised by geodesic/tangent-consistent vertex codes). Then (a) occluded/missing body regions are explicitly detected as 3D vertices with no supporting pixel, yielding a per-vertex visibility/support map for free, and (b) two images are matched only over their shared visible 3D vertices (\"common visible support\"), making the comparison occlusion-robust without relying on holistic features. The cross-frame \"same-vertex => consistent embedding\" constraint also provides a structural prior to inpaint or down-weight corrupted regions.",

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:6046:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:6047:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:6052:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4268:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6121:独立审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 的 LSRC 训练端机制(loss_mode=='lsrc' 段, 约 line 421-443; args line 58-66)。背景: LM-ReID 把低分辨率 ReID 形式化为采样格点隐变量, test-time 对 K=9 lattice 变体做 decision marginalization(logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)); 现在加训练端 LSRC=full fine-tune backbone, loss = L_id(CE+per-slot batch-hard triplet) + lam_lsrc*(bag-to-bag set-supcon[对所有图对的 M×M lattice-pair cos 做 logsumexp 当 set score, 再 batch-softmax 拉近同 id] + lam_negtail*neg-tail[softplus 压低负样本对的 max lattice-pair cos] + lam_coverage*coverage[top-M 正样本 lattice-pair])。逐行查: (1)runtime/shape/数值 bug; (2)self-pair/对角 mask 是否正确排除; (3)train(M×M 对称 bag-to-bag) vs test(query LR K 变体 × gallery HR 单图)的 marginalization 是否够对齐, 会不会 train/test mismatch 导致训练目标跑偏; (4)和已证伪的 consistency(塌缩)/L_marg(分类头边缘化无 headroom)是否真有本质区别还是换皮; (5)联网查 set-based contrastive + lattice/sampling 当隐变量在 LR-ReID 的 novelty 先例。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention) + findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low) + 简短中文结论。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:6074:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8057:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:6077:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:6081:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8109:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3567:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:14:独立审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 的 LSRC 训练端机制(loss_mode=='lsrc' 段, 约 line 421-443; args line 58-66)。背景: LM-ReID 把低分辨率 ReID 形式化为采样格点隐变量, test-time 对 K=9 lattice 变体做 decision marginalization(logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)); 现在加训练端 LSRC=full fine-tune backbone, loss = L_id(CE+per-slot batch-hard triplet) + lam_lsrc*(bag-to-bag set-supcon[对所有图对的 M×M lattice-pair cos 做 logsumexp 当 set score, 再 batch-softmax 拉近同 id] + lam_negtail*neg-tail[softplus 压低负样本对的 max lattice-pair cos] + lam_coverage*coverage[top-M 正样本 lattice-pair])。逐行查: (1)runtime/shape/数值 bug; (2)self-pair/对角 mask 是否正确排除; (3)train(M×M 对称 bag-to-bag) vs test(query LR K 变体 × gallery HR 单图)的 marginalization 是否够对齐, 会不会 train/test mismatch 导致训练目标跑偏; (4)和已证伪的 consistency(塌缩)/L_marg(分类头边缘化无 headroom)是否真有本质区别还是换皮; (5)联网查 set-based contrastive + lattice/sampling 当隐变量在 LR-ReID 的 novelty 先例。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention) + findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low) + 简短中文结论。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_train_design.md:6082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8529:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:3716:**上下文**: 三个独立 codex(终身 d3 / 开集 d9 / 长尾 d10)收敛到同一 re-framing: ReID 失败由 GALLERY 组成(规模/膨胀/分布)驱动, 非只看 query/模型。用户要求零训练验证, ★铁律=每个 per-query 相关都控 trivial 代理(吸取 HUBNESS §7.6 教训: 上个诊断被漏控 #false-in-topk 证伪)。脚本 `cvpb_gallery_killswitch.py`, 复用 hubness 缓存特征, Market exp260b + Occluded-Duke exp255。双审(Claude broad 5 blocking 全修 + Codex)。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8539:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:6008:- few-shot / mixed data：CFReID、ReMix 说明少样本/混合单摄像头数据已有先例，但“标准监督 ReID 中强制 single-support 表征学习”仍有空白。来源：[CFReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18469)、[ReMix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21938)
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8540:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:6013:1. **Single-Support CVaR Episodic Loss**
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8541:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:6014:核心：训练时每个 ID 只允许一个 support 图代表身份，query 必须从这个单图 support 中恢复身份边界；再对最差 support 选择做 CVaR/worst-case 优化。它直接回应 `single-image support incomplete`，不是测试侧，也不是范式重定义，最终仍输出常规 ReID descriptor。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8542:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:6018:第一步 kill-switch：零训练。用现有 checkpoint 做 single-support gallery probe：每个 gallery ID 只留 1 张图，分别报 random-support / worst-support / best-support / full-gallery mAP。若 random 或 worst 比 full 掉 >3 mAP，且 best-support 能追回 >=2 mAP，说明 support 选择是真瓶颈。否则 kill。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8543:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:6034:4. **Natural Camera-Pose Subgroup CVaR**
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8544:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:6044:下一步最务实：先做候选 1 的零训练 single-support probe。它最贴合 `exp109` 根问题，且不需要新依赖、不改 batch size、不碰测试侧。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:8545:experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_trainside_innovation.md:6055:- few-shot / mixed data：CFReID、ReMix 说明少样本/混合单摄像头数据已有先例，但“标准监督 ReID 中强制 single-support 表征学习”仍有空白。来源：[CFReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.18469)、[ReMix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21938)

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:10763:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4485:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6436:初步查到的形势：ReID 里 test-time 不是禁区，k-reciprocal re-ranking 这种纯后处理曾进 CVPR；TTA/flip TTA 也有专门论文讨论训练-推理 gap。但“sampling lattice / aliasing”在 ReID 里没搜到直接成熟路线，更多是通用视觉里的 shift/aliasing 先例。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:10764:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4490:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11500:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2701:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11531:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3491:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1637:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py:69:ap.add_argument('--cache_gallery', default='/tmp/lattice_gallery_hr.npz')
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11532:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3528:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1739:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:17:1. **vs 普通 TTA**：相同 K、相同融合（mean / MaxSim），但 K 个 view 是普通 test-time aug（pad+RandomCrop + hflip）of 单一 bicubic LR，**无 lattice 语义**。phase-lattice 必须明显超过普通 TTA（否则只是 TTA 换名）。MaxSim 对照尤其关键：MaxSim 取 K 中最优可能仅靠"多枪"涨点，TTA-MaxSim 同样多枪 → 差值才是 lattice 特有增益。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11533:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3555:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1926:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:148:ReID 里的 TTA 也不能忽略。FlipReID 已指出 ReID 常用 original+horizontal flip 的 feature mean，并专门处理训练-推理 TTA gap。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.05639?utm_source=openai)) 所以你必须反复强调：这不是普通 TTA 换名，因为你有同 K vs-TTA 控制，且 lattice-K 比 TTA 多 +3.04 mAP。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11534:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3826:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3833:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:18:- Medium-4 (L_id triplet over flat B*M): now L_tri = mean_m batch_hard_triplet(gf_bm[:,m], y, margin) per lattice slot.
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11535:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:3864:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11754:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2024:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1161:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1739:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:17:1. **vs 普通 TTA**：相同 K、相同融合（mean / MaxSim），但 K 个 view 是普通 test-time aug（pad+RandomCrop + hflip）of 单一 bicubic LR，**无 lattice 语义**。phase-lattice 必须明显超过普通 TTA（否则只是 TTA 换名）。MaxSim 对照尤其关键：MaxSim 取 K 中最优可能仅靠"多枪"涨点，TTA-MaxSim 同样多枪 → 差值才是 lattice 特有增益。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11755:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:5488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2051:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1188:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1926:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:148:ReID 里的 TTA 也不能忽略。FlipReID 已指出 ReID 常用 original+horizontal flip 的 feature mean，并专门处理训练-推理 TTA gap。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.05639?utm_source=openai)) 所以你必须反复强调：这不是普通 TTA 换名，因为你有同 K vs-TTA 控制，且 lattice-K 比 TTA 多 +3.04 mAP。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:11793:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6607:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率=采样格点隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 已成立6/10)。**训练端三大类实测全死**: frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT final-feat +0.028/LPA +0.075 无headroom) / backbone改loss(LSRC full-finetune −1.9损判别力HR sanity掉3点/consistency −1.73) / robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)。**input-canonicalize(BLC)被现有数据证伪**: canonicalize bbox(主因子LM-S4 +2.84)= 固定canonical放弃marginalize bbox大收益, 只剩phase/zoom marginalize(+1.7)<marginalize-all(+2.557); 且market测试用标注框(已canonical), BLC会让K=9 marginalize退化成single 77.44<79.90。fourthclass codex给的LATS(frozen-token sidecar)是frozen-adaptation子类(已证无headroom)且实现不cheap(featmaps 18GB cache)。**问: 给定这些, 还有没有任何CHEAP(不需大cache/不改backbone主干/小实现/<1天)且机制上可能正收益的训练端机制? 还是训练端在这个问题(severe LR+market cropped+强no-LM backbone)上确定无空间(no-LM已最优, test-time marginalization是唯一杠杆)? 如果确定无空间就直说别硬凑, 这本身是论文强论点。** 务实中文+信心1-10。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:12273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:13230:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4293:experiments/results.md:1587:> post-PRCV（PRCV 已投后）的复现/multi-seed/LR sweep/loss-weight sweep/SOTA push。**整体结论：无一超越已投 baseline**，产出是消融素材而非训练端涨点。`eq` = equal_concat+flip（train-side 默认）；`MaxSim` = MaxSim hybrid+flip（test-time 后处理，**不算训练端贡献**）。Δ 用 MaxSim 口径。
experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:12274:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:13348:experiments/exp343_pose_guided_clip/claude_review.md:67:- **Low-2 (config 死设置，无害但误导)**：exp343/exp341 都设了 `POSE_TEST_FEAT: 'equal_concat'`，但 clip-only 路径**没有任何部位分支**会去读它——`self.pose_test_feat` 属性在 `__init__` 仅于部位分支 if 块内赋值（line 168/187/235/279/333），clip-only 下从不赋值；eval 端用 `getattr(self,'pose_test_feat','global')` 回退到 `'global'`，且所有 `use_*` 为 False 使每个 elif 跳过。故该设置**完全不被读取**，最终 eval 必为 GAP global。无功能影响，但字面误导（像在用 LGPA 的 equal_concat）。建议把它改成 `'global'` 或删除以免日后误读。

experiments/exp367_single_support/codex_laststage_design.md:13430:experiments/exp290_target_s_op_s42/claude_review.md:139:`getattr(cfg.MODEL, 'POSE_USE_TARGET_HEATMAP', False)` at pose_backbone_model.py:135 handles: (a) old YAML configs without the key, (b) older trained checkpoints whose cfg is reconstructed from file, (c) hot-swaps where the attribute was absent. Combined with the default `_C.MODEL.POSE_USE_TARGET_HEATMAP = False` in `config/defaults.py:110`, the flag is rock-solid. YAML override like `MODEL.POSE_USE_TARGET_HEATMAP: True` or command-line `MODEL.POSE_USE_TARGET_HEATMAP True` both work with yacs merge.

**Verdict: needs-attention**

不能 approve 跑正式 backbone 训练。已无明显 runtime blocker，但还有一个会影响实验结论的 High 残留。

**Findings**

- **High** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:267): train 仍然在 `POSE_ENABLED=True` 时传入 `pose_dict`，而 eval 在 [line 183](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:183) 强制 `pose_dict=None / use_pose=False`。也就是说，`ss_episode_loss` 优化的是 pose-on/PSG 激活后的训练 descriptor，但诊断看的是 probe v2 的 pose-off global descriptor。这不是纯 runtime bug，但会让 last-stage 结果无法干净回答“CVaR 是否改善 probe v2 descriptor”。建议训练 forward 也强制 pose-off：即使 dataloader 返回 `pose_dict`，这里也调用 `model(img, ..., pose_dict=None)`，让 SS loss 和 eval descriptor 同口径。

- **Medium** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:278): 上面 pose-on train 还会触发 LGPA/GCN list-output loss 路径。part 分支大多 detached/frozen，不会有效更新 backbone，但会改变 base loss 的全局项权重和日志数值；这和设计里的“CE+Triplet + SS-CVaR on regular descriptor”不完全一致。若训练也 pose-off，这个问题基本消失。

- **Low / monitor risk** [ss_cvar_laststage.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp367_single_support/ss_cvar_laststage.py:134): two-level CVaR 实现本身是对的，AMP `feat.float()` 也已修。但默认 `P=16,K=4` 仍可能让 `ss_ce/ss_cvar` 很快接近 0，复现 frozen N=16 的空转风险。不是阻塞 bug，启动后要把 `ss_ce/ss_cvar` 作为硬止损指标看。

其余检查通过：`make_optimizer/create_scheduler` 接口、P×K label guard、train/val batch 解包、`NECK_FEAT=after`、eval probe v2 的 common-valid/distractor/random f10 口径、`norm3` 解冻和 AMP 数值处理都没看到新问题。改掉 train pose-off 后，可以 approve 跑正式 last-stage。
